observation.new_content:
import pytest

from toyapp.pagination import CursorPage, page_numbers, paginate, paginate_cursor
from toyapp.tokens import decode_offset, encode_offset


def test_page_number_api_remains_one_based() -> None:
    assert paginate(["a", "b", "c"], page=1, per_page=2).items == ["a", "b"]
    assert paginate(["a", "b", "c"], page=2, per_page=2).items == ["c"]


def test_page_number_validation_is_preserved() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        paginate(["a"], page=0, per_page=1)
    assert page_numbers(5, 2) == [1, 2, 3]


def test_paginate_cursor_traverses_next_pages() -> None:
    first = paginate_cursor(["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"], per_page=2)
    assert isinstance(first, CursorPage)
    assert first.items == ["a", "b"]
    assert first.has_more is True
    assert first.next_cursor == encode_offset(2)

    second = paginate_cursor(["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"], first.next_cursor, 2)
    assert second.items == ["c", "d"]
    assert second.has_more is True

    third = paginate_cursor(["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"], second.next_cursor, 2)
    assert third.items == ["e"]
    assert third.has_more is False
    assert third.next_cursor is None


def test_paginate_cursor_empty_and_exhausted() -> None:
    assert paginate_cursor([]) == CursorPage([], None, False)
    assert paginate_cursor([1], encode_offset(100), 2) == CursorPage([], None, False)


def test_paginate_cursor_validation() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        paginate_cursor([1], per_page=0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        paginate_cursor([1], cursor=encode_offset(-1))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        paginate_cursor([1], cursor="%%%")
    assert decode_offset(paginate_cursor([1, 2, 3], per_page=2).next_cursor) == 2
